evidence: Turner explicitly gives Marathi āgṭhī, āgṭī and ākṭī heap of kindled sticks under agniṣṭha, beside Gujarati ãgīṭhī fireplace and Konkani āgṭī brazier. These adjoining Bhili/Bareli and Nimadi fire words preserve the diagnostic ṭ(h) extension; the broader fire sense follows the attested burning-sticks meaning, rather than simple agni.
Turner explicitly lists Lahnda bhā fire/flame under bhāsa light, with Punjabi bhāh. The Siraiki bhā survey response directly matches that Lahnda fire word.
